paragraphs.en: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
paragraphs.zh: Orca 是用于管理一群智能体（例如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）的工作平台。 使用你自己的订阅运行任意编码智能体。 支持桌面端、移动端和远程运行时。

sents.en: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code).
sents.zh: Orca 是用于管理一群智能体（例如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）的工作平台。

sents.en: Run any coding agent with your own subscription.
sents.zh: 使用你自己的订阅运行任意编码智能体。

sents.en: Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
sents.zh: 支持桌面端、移动端和远程运行时。

paragraphs.en: 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português
paragraphs.zh: 中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português

paragraphs.en: The AI Orchestrator for 100x builders. Run Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side — each in its own worktree, tracked in one place.
paragraphs.zh: 面向百倍效率构建者的 AI 编排器。 并行运行 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode 或 Pi——每个智能体都在自己的 worktree 中，并在同一处集中追踪。

sents.zh: 面向百倍效率构建者的 AI 编排器。

sents.en: Run Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side — each in its own worktree, tracked in one place.
sents.zh: 并行运行 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode 或 Pi——每个智能体都在自己的 worktree 中，并在同一处集中追踪。

paragraphs.en: Monitor and steer your agents from your phone — get notified when an agent finishes and send follow-ups from anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 在手机上监控并操控你的智能体——当智能体完成任务时会收到通知，并可在任何地方发送后续指令。

paragraphs.en: Parallel Worktrees Fan one prompt across five agents, each in its own isolated git worktree — compare the results and merge the winner.
paragraphs.zh: 并行工作树（Worktrees）将一个提示词分发到五个智能体，每个智能体都在各自隔离的 git 工作树中运行——对比结果并合并胜出者。

paragraphs.en: Terminal Splits Ghostty-class terminals with WebGL rendering, infinite splits, and scrollback that survives restarts.
paragraphs.zh: 终端拆分 Ghostty 级别的终端，支持 WebGL 渲染、无限拆分，以及重启后仍可保留的回滚缓冲区。

paragraphs.en: Design Mode Click any UI element in a real Chromium window to send its HTML, CSS, and a cropped screenshot straight into your agent's prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 设计模式：点击真实 Chromium 窗口中的任意 UI 元素，将其 HTML、CSS 和裁剪后的截图直接发送到你的智能体的提示词中。

paragraphs.en: GitHub & Linear, Native Browse PRs, issues, and project boards in-app — open a worktree from any task and review without a context switch.
paragraphs.zh: GitHub 和 Linear、原生浏览 PR、issue 和项目看板——直接在应用内操作，可从任意任务打开 worktree，无需切换上下文即可进行代码评审。

paragraphs.en: SSH Worktrees Run agents on a beefy remote box with full file editing, git, and terminals — auto-reconnect and port forwarding included.
paragraphs.zh: SSH Worktrees 在一台配置强劲的远程机器上运行智能体，支持完整的文件编辑、git 和终端——并内置自动重连和端口转发。

paragraphs.en: Annotate AI Diffs Drop comments on any diff line and ship them back to the agent — review, edit, and commit without leaving Orca.
paragraphs.zh: 标注 AI 差异 在任意 diff 行上添加评论，并将其发送回智能体——无需离开 Orca 即可完成审查、编辑和提交。

paragraphs.en: Drag Files to Agents VS Code's editor with autosave everywhere — drag files or images straight into an agent prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 在启用全局自动保存的 VS Code 编辑器中，将文件拖放到智能体——直接将文件或图片拖入智能体提示框。

paragraphs.en: Orca CLI Agents drive Orca too — script every workflow with orca worktree create , snapshot , click , and fill .
paragraphs.zh: Orca CLI 智能体也能驱动 Orca —— 使用 orca worktree create、snapshot、click 和 fill 以脚本方式编排每一个工作流。

paragraphs.en: Works with any CLI agent — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Orca.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于任何 CLI 智能体——只要它能在终端中运行，就能在 Orca 中运行。

paragraphs.en: # macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source yay -S stably-orca-bin Mobile Companion — iOS, Android Pair with your desktop app to monitor and steer your agents from your phone.
paragraphs.zh: # macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Arch Linux (AUR) — 或者使用 stably-orca-git 从源码构建 yay -S stably-orca-bin 移动伴侣 — iOS、Android 与你的桌面应用配对，即可通过手机监控和操控你的智能体。
